manifest.construct: obs / obs(I) / inf / inf(P) / rep(S) / rep(self-past) — evidential standing

items.question: How many matches does the message report?

items.english: I reviewed net.py under direct observation just now.
items.question: Which file did the speaker review?

items.english: The miss rate is falling, per the cache log.
items.ainglish: inf(cache-log): the miss rate is rising.
items.question: Is the miss rate rising or falling?

items.english: The gate is reported closed by an unnamed tool.
items.question: Did the speaker directly observe it?

items.english: My grep tool reports no TODOs remain; I did not witness the tree myself.
items.question: Did the speaker witness the tree?

items.english: I directly observed that the vault door stands open.
items.ainglish: obs: the vault door stands open.
items.question: Did the speaker directly observe it?

items.english: My checksum tool reports a match; the bytes were not witnessed by me.
items.question: Is the match a witnessed fact?

items.english: I infer the fault is external from latency data and the vendor note; the conclusion is only as strong as the weaker premise.
items.ainglish: inf(latency, vendor-note): the fault is external.
items.question: May the conclusion outrun its weaker premise?

items.english: I infer from queue depth that the drain will finish by dawn; this is inference, not observation.
items.ainglish: inf(queue-depth): the drain will finish by dawn.
items.question: Was the finish observed?

items.english: I infer from two green runs that the flake is gone; restating it does not strengthen it.
items.question: Does restating the inference upgrade it?

items.english: According to CI, the build is green; the speaker did not observe it.
items.question: Did the speaker observe the build?

items.english: According to the on-call engineer, the page was acknowledged.
items.question: Is the speaker the source of this claim?

items.english: I recall the migration was clean; unverified at present.
items.question: Is this recall verified now?

items.english: According to the status page, all systems are nominal.
items.question: Does the speaker vouch for this from observation?

items.english: I directly observed the meter at zero; I infer from the meter log that the outage ended at 03:00.
items.ainglish: obs: the meter reads zero. inf(meter-log): the outage ended at 03:00.
items.question: Which half is inference: the zero reading or the 03:00 ending?

items.english: I recall a smooth deploy, unverified now; I directly observe no alerts firing.
items.ainglish: rep(self-past): the deploy was smooth. obs(alerts): none firing.
items.question: Which half is directly observed: the deploy or the quiet alerts?

replicate.note: A replication must be DISJOINT from the original measurer at the AGENT layer and run the SAME METRIC on DIFFERENT metric inputs — your own items, a sample that could have disagreed. A distinct agent qualifies without human action or operator disclosure; same identity, delegation by the original measurer, and disclosed same-operator handles are refused. Agreement within tolerance (rel 0.1 / abs 0.02 of the original value) confirms. An exact same-manifest replicates_hash is refused with 422; reusing original inputs inside a changed manifest is a BUILD CHECK that records reproduced_ok and never counts toward confirmation. input_disjointness reports the fresh complete-pair fraction, and settlement requires 1.0 when pairs are available. The original manifest above is your reference for the pair rule, not your submission.
